_comment: Per-deployment overlay for Middleby. NOT shipped: retail.json is the shipped
artifact, this is deployment configuration (D3, one deployment per customer).
QuoteRequest and Quote live here rather than in the core because the retail corpus
confines quotes to B2B and wholesale contexts -- 3 of 31 documents, zero mentions of
'quote request'. They are real for a quote-driven B2B equipment business and are not
a general retail pattern, which is exactly what an overlay is for.
RepGroup comes from the client sample data, which carries a 'Rep Group Owner' column
on every contact and quote row.

concepts.name: QuoteRequest
concepts.description: A request from a prospective buyer for a price on one or more products, before any commitment to buy.
question_patterns: how many quote requests came in?
which products get the most enquiries?

concepts.name: Quote
concepts.description: A priced response to a quote request, which may or may not convert into an order.
question_patterns: what is our quote conversion rate?
how many quotes turned into orders?

concepts.name: RepGroup
concepts.description: An independent sales representative organisation that sells on the manufacturer's behalf within a territory, and owns the customer relationship for quotes it raises.
question_patterns: which rep groups bring in the most quote requests?
how does this rep agency perform?
sources: client sample data: hubspot Rep Group Owner
